versions.content: Notify applications about the clearing of an event Description: Interested monitoring application shall be notified about the clearing of event status information and event related data. Rationale: Monitor reinitialization can be triggered by the clear notification. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: After the event status is cleared diagnostic in AUTOSAR informs the relevant monitoring application which can be reinitialized.
